description: This file is the main include file for the ADODB PHP library, providing core functionality for database abstraction, connection management, query execution, error handling, and caching. It defines constants, classes, and functions used throughout the library, making it a foundational component for database interactions in PHP projects.

classes.name: ADOFieldObject
classes.description: Helper class representing metadata for a database column, including name, maximum length, and data type.

classes.name: ADODB_Cache_File
classes.description: Implements file-based caching for database recordsets, including methods for reading, writing, and flushing cache files.

classes.name: ADOConnection
classes.description: Abstract class managing database connections, executing queries, handling transactions, and providing metadata and error reporting functionalities.

classes.name: ADODB_Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class to traverse through database recordsets using MoveNext and other methods.

classes.name: ADODB_Iterator_empty
classes.description: Iterator class for empty or non-existent recordsets, providing stub implementations.

classes.name: ADORecordSet
classes.description: Main class representing a dataset returned by the database, providing methods for row navigation, data retrieval, and recordset management.

classes.name: ADODBFetchObj
classes.description: Internal placeholder class used for record object fetching mechanisms.

classes.name: ADODB_DateAndTime
classes.description: Includes date/time functions like UnixDate, UnixTimeStamp, UserDate, UserTimeStamp, used for converting database date formats to Unix timestamps and vice versa.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array
classes.description: Encapsulates a recordset created in memory as a 2D array, useful for cached recordsets.

methods.name: ADODB_Setup
methods.description: Initializes global configuration, constants, and global variables for the ADODB library.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator object for traversing the recordset.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the recordset.

methods.name: RowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the recordset.

methods.name: GetArray
methods.description: Retrieves all rows as a two-dimensional array.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next row.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves cursor to a specific row number.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Returns the value of specified field in the current row.

methods.name: UserDate
methods.description: Formats a database date string into a user-defined date format.

methods.name: UnixDate
methods.description: Converts a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: UnixTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: addQ
methods.description: Quotes a string without enclosing quotes, escaping internal quotes as needed.

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Quotes a string, adding surrounding single quotes for SQL.

methods.name: PageExecute
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with pagination support.

methods.name: CacheExecute
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement with optional caching.

methods.name: autoExecute
methods.description: Automates insert or update operations based on the provided data.

methods.name: GetUpdateSQL
methods.description: Generates an SQL UPDATE statement based on recordset data.

methods.name: GetInsertSQL
methods.description: Generates an SQL INSERT statement based on recordset data.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB column with data.

methods.name: updateBlobFile
methods.description: Updates a BLOB column with data from a file.

methods.name: getCharSet
methods.description: Returns the current character set of the database connection.

methods.name: setCharSet
methods.description: Sets the character set for the database connection.

methods.name: SetDateLocale
methods.description: Sets date formatting locale for the connection.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns metadata for columns of a table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Lists all tables or views in the current database.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Lists available databases.

methods.name: MetaProcedures
methods.description: Lists procedures and functions in the database.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Lists indexes on a table.

methods.name: ConCat
methods.description: Concatenates strings using database-specific operator.

methods.name: DBDate
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to a database date string.

methods.name: DBTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to a database timestamp string.

methods.name: UserTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a database timestamp into a user-defined format.

methods.name: UserDate
methods.description: Formats a database date into a user-defined format.

methods.name: recordCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the recordset.
